steps.code:
<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
delete_transient('_wc_activation_redirect');
update_option('woocommerce_onboarding_profile', array('skipped'=>true, 'completed'=>true));
if (function_exists('wc_get_product_id_by_sku') && class_exists('WC_Product_Simple') && ! wc_get_product_id_by_sku('demo-smartphone')) {
  $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
  $p->set_name('Fairline 6 Smartphone 128 GB'); $p->set_sku('demo-smartphone'); $p->set_regular_price('499.00');
  $p->set_short_description('6.1-inch smartphone with a user-replaceable battery and a modular back cover.');
  $p->set_description('Eco-friendly packaging made from recycled paper. Climate neutral shipping.');
  $p->update_meta_data('_garantio_durability_years', 5);
  $p->update_meta_data('_garantio_durability_producer', 'Fairline');
  $p->update_meta_data('_garantio_repair_score', 'B');
  $p->set_status('publish'); $p->save();
}
